description: This file defines the PackageManager class for SuiteCRM, handling module/package management including installation, uninstallation, updates, credentials, and communication with external repositories.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main class for managing package/module installation, updates, credentials, and communication with external repositories in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database connection and upload directory.

methods.name: initializeComm
methods.description: Placeholder for initializing communication, currently empty.

methods.name: getPromotion
methods.description: Retrieves a promotion string from SugarDepot.

methods.name: getModuleLoaderCategoryPackages
methods.description: Gets category packages for modules, themes, and language packs.

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Fetches category packages from SugarDepot, building a nested structure with categories, packages, and releases.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves categories from SugarDepot.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages within a category from SugarDepot.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Fetches releases for a specific package.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specific release file from SugarDepot.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials with SugarDepot and stores them.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials in the administration settings.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves stored user credentials.

methods.name: getTermsAndConditions
methods.description: Fetches terms and conditions from SugarDepot.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for available updates for installed modules.

methods.name: toNameValueList
methods.description: Converts an associative array to a list of name-value pairs.

methods.name: toNameValueLists
methods.description: Converts multiple arrays to lists of name-value pairs.

methods.name: fromNameValueList
methods.description: Converts a list of name-value pairs back to an associative array.

methods.name: buildInstalledReleases
methods.description: Builds a list of installed module releases.

methods.name: buildPackageXML
methods.description: Creates an XML representation of a package and its releases.

methods.name: addToCleanup
methods.description: Registers a directory for cleanup on shutdown.

methods.name: cleanUpTempDir
methods.description: Removes registered temporary directories.

methods.name: extractFile
methods.description: Extracts a specific file from a zip archive.

methods.name: extractManifest
methods.description: Extracts the manifest.php file from a zip archive.

methods.name: validateManifestType
methods.description: Validates the type specified in a manifest.

methods.name: validateManifestVersion
methods.description: Validates the version compatibility specified in a manifest.

methods.name: validate_manifest
methods.description: Validates the entire manifest including type and version compatibility.

methods.name: getInstallType
methods.description: Determines the install type based on directory structure.

methods.name: performSetup
methods.description: Performs setup of an uploaded package, including validation and copying files.

methods.name: unlinkTempFiles
methods.description: Removes temporary uploaded files.

methods.name: performInstall
methods.description: Installs a package zip file into SuiteCRM.

methods.name: performUninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by name.

methods.name: getUITextForType
methods.description: Returns human-readable text for package types.

methods.name: getImageForType
methods.description: Returns icon images for package types.

methods.name: getPackagesInStaging
methods.description: Lists packages in staging area for upload.

methods.name: getLicenseFromFile
methods.description: Retrieves license text from a package file.

methods.name: getInstalled
methods.description: Queries installed modules of specified types.

methods.name: getinstalledPackages
methods.description: Returns detailed info about installed packages, including manifest data.
